                                                  Dear Jeffrey


           After a wonderful six year collaboration with Mack Scogin Merrill Elam Architects, Michael
            Mayer of Franz Mayer, the General Services Administration and our good friends Judge
               Andrew Austin and Judge Lee Yeakel, "The Austin Wall" is ready to be unveiled.


                See the invitation below from the City of Austin and some of its leading cultural
             organizations to attend the unveiling ceremony on June 18th, 2013 in Austin, Texas.


            We hope you can join us in the great city of Austin for the celebration, and of course for
           some music and barbecue. Direct flights are available from most cities, and special rates
              have been negotiated at several local hotels. Please contact studio manager Jaime
                              Endreny a                            for information.




       The Community of Austin is proud to welcome
       The Austin Wall
       an original stained glass artwork created by artist
       Clifford Ross
       Commissioned by the General Services Administration
       for the newly constructed Austin U.S. Federal Courthouse
       Designed by Mack Scogin Merrill Elam Architects
       Stained Glass manufactured by Franz Mayer
